runs.question: Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
runs.answer:
[Turn 1 | session=ses_0a0f08529ffeCFUzjzhaBzst2n] Query the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet blocks on 20 June 2026 (UTC).
Here are the first-seen block arrival times for mainnet on 20 June 2026 (UTC).

**Summary (7180 blocks):**

| Metric | Value |
|---|---|
| Total blocks | 7,180 |
| Fastest arrival | 141 ms |
| Median arrival | 1,453 ms |
| P95 arrival | 3,126 ms |
| Slowest arrival | 5,249 ms |

**Sample rows (first 20):**

| Slot | Slot Start | First Arrival (ms) | Observations |
|---|---|---|---|
| 14590799 | 2026-06-20 00:00:11 | 1,773 | 157 |
| 14590800 | 2026-06-20 00:00:23 | 3,142 | 157 |
| 14590801 | 2026-06-20 00:00:35 | 1,609 | 157 |
| ... | ... | ... | ... |

The query used:

```sql
SELECT
  slot,
  slot_start_date_time,
  min(seen_slot_start_diff) as first_arrival_ms,
  count() as observations
FROM mainnet.fct_block_first_seen_by_node FINAL
WHERE slot_start_date_time >= '2026-06-20 00:00:00'
  AND slot_start_date_time < '2026-06-21 00:00:00'
GROUP BY slot, slot_start_date_time
ORDER BY slot ASC
```

To get the full dataset (all 7180 rows), redirect the output to a file:

```
panda clickhouse query-raw clickhouse-refined "...full query..." --format TSV > /tmp/block_arrivals_2026-06-20.tsv
```
